en.topic_title: China draws up safety rules for autonomous vehicles
en.topic_summary:
China has drawn up new safety rules for the growing number of autonomous vehicles on its roads, including a mandatory deactivation override, the government said Tuesday.



The photo taken on August 1, 2024 shows a driverless robotaxi autonomous vehicle developed by Baidu Apollo driving along a street in Wuhan, central China’s Hubei province. Photo: Pedro Pardo/AFP.
